primary_metric: Repository normalized field-value multiset micro F1. Nulls count as values. Macro is an unweighted average of class-level field F1.
metric_fuzzy_five: Secondary proxy credits residual non-null string matches within the same field at normalized Levenshtein similarity >= 0.8, one-to-one. Paths: Odwolujacy[].pelnomocnik.nazwa, przelew_bankowy.tytul, Odwolujacy[].nazwa, Zamawiajacy[].nazwa, ZamowieniePubliczne.tytul.
datasets: All 30 public organizer scans are development examples. C1 dev (22) is included in C1 all (39). The 91-PDF pooled set contains C1 dev, C2 dev (39), and the organizer scans (30). C2 test is reserved for final integration.
timing_note: The screening matrix used primary OCR reuse and exact API response reuse when a document, URL and full JSON request matched. HTTP counts in this matrix count requests required by the profile, including replayed successful requests. Cold CLI figures are reported separately.

rerun_protocol.models_live_once: The 8B comparison used live completions once, with cached OCR; the post-merge score uses the same successful completions. The tested regional 3B configuration was also run with fresh OCR and fresh requests on a 150-PDF batch.

timing.method: one cold CLI invocation; per-group windows may overlap; no OCR or model replay; public timing only
